observation_source: Owner confirmed stage4/restoration/global fault values; remaining values manually transcribed from the attached photograph.

photo.note: Attachment visible in conversation; supplied local file absent, so photo hash remains unknown.

conclusion: ID, VALID under FAULT, and inactive S2CR fields accepted the tested values and restored exactly. Direct FAULT restore succeeded; no fallback was needed.
limits: No context write or DMA/UFS command was performed.
CB0..4 contain existing configuration; context visibility and SCTLR.M=0 do not prove ownership.
CB73 SCTLR=3ab3a706 is not a verified clean/free context and must not be selected merely because it is the last bank.
CB0..4 FSR=400 has no before-test context baseline, so it cannot be attributed to this test; GFSR=0 does not mean every context fault register is zero.
No evidence for the Qualcomm FAULT-write quirk in this run; fallbackRead=0 is an unused default.
next_action: Review a bounded transport plan using an exclusive, fully validated bypass context, preserving display CB4 and avoiding unqualified CB73; keep command and DMA validation separate from field writeback.
